summary: Map-entry decoding ignored unknown field tags without consuming their payloads, causing payload bytes to be interpreted as subsequent fields and potentially corrupting decoding or producing errors. The fix calls skip_field to consume the unknown field correctly. The verbatim reversal is isolated, but no detecting upstream test was established at this revision: map properties round-trip known fields, the checked-in fuzz regression cases do not exercise this branch, and the conformance wrapper delegates to an external suite. Leave this candidate blocked pending an existing detecting test; no tests were executed.
